title: Malformed JSON, invalid UTF-8, bad timestamps, ignored record kinds and a missing model
policy: P7: records that can't be read are not counted and are reported as unread (#58): malformed JSON and invalid UTF-8 as malformed, a missing or unparsable timestamp as undated. Neither has a period. User records and <synthetic> records carry no billable usage and are ignored, not unread. A record without a model is counted under "unknown", whose cost is unknown.
derivation: Counted: A [100, 50], B [20, 2] (claude-test-1) and M [11, 1] (no model). Not counted: truncated JSON, invalid UTF-8, a timestamp without a zone or T, no timestamp, a user record, a <synthetic> record. 184 tokens, 3 operations. Unread: 2 malformed (the truncated JSON and the invalid UTF-8) and 2 undated (no zone or T; no timestamp). Before #58 they left no trace.
